genes.name: Apolipoprotein E
genes.function: Lipid transport protein; APOE epsilon4 allele is the primary genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease.
genes.disease_evidence: Strong genetic risk factor (OR ~3.0 for single e4 allele, ~12.0 for homozygotes); impairs amyloid-beta clearance.

genes.name: Amyloid Beta Precursor Protein
genes.function: Transmembrane precursor cleaved by beta- and gamma-secretases to yield neurotoxic Abeta peptides.
genes.disease_evidence: Autosomal dominant causative mutations in early-onset AD; gene duplication causes AD in Down syndrome.

genes.name: Microtubule Associated Protein Tau
genes.function: Promotes microtubule assembly and stability; hyperphosphorylated Tau forms paired helical filaments.
genes.disease_evidence: Primary component of neurofibrillary tangles; correlates directly with cognitive decline severity.

genes.name: Presenilin 1
genes.function: Catalytic subunit of gamma-secretase complex responsible for intramembrane cleavage of APP.
genes.disease_evidence: Most common cause of autosomal dominant early-onset familial Alzheimer's disease (>200 mutations).

genes.name: Presenilin 2
genes.function: Catalytic subunit of gamma-secretase complex involved in processing precursor proteins.
genes.disease_evidence: Causative mutations identified in early-onset familial AD families (e.g. Volga German AD lineage).

genes.name: Triggering Receptor Expressed On Myeloid Cells 2
genes.function: Microglial cell-surface receptor mediating lipid sensing, microglial survival, and amyloid plaque containment.
genes.disease_evidence: R47H and loss-of-function variants confer 2-4x increased risk for late-onset AD.

genes.name: Beta-Secretase 1
genes.function: Transmembrane aspartyl protease initiating amyloidogenic cleavage of APP at the N-terminus of Abeta.
genes.disease_evidence: Primary enzyme generating Abeta peptide; therapeutic inhibition target.

genes.name: Clusterin
genes.function: Extracellular chaperone preventing protein aggregation; regulates complement cascade and amyloid transport.
genes.disease_evidence: GWAS locus associated with late-onset AD risk; modulates amyloid deposition.

genes.name: Complement C3b/C4b Receptor 1
genes.function: Mediates complement activation, immune complex adherence, and opsonized amyloid clearance.
genes.disease_evidence: GWAS confirmed risk locus for late-onset AD.

genes.name: Phosphatidylinositol Binding Clathrin Assembly Protein
genes.function: Involved in clathrin-mediated endocytosis and APP intracellular trafficking.
genes.disease_evidence: Top GWAS candidate modulating endocytic Abeta uptake and clearance.

genes.name: Bridging Integrator 1
genes.function: Regulates membrane dynamics, endocytosis, and microglial tau pathology propagation.
genes.disease_evidence: Second strongest late-onset AD GWAS locus after APOE.

genes.name: CD33 Molecule (Siglec-3)
genes.function: Microglial transmembrane receptor inhibiting microglial uptake and phagocytosis of Abeta.
genes.disease_evidence: GWAS risk locus; CD33 inhibition promotes microglial plaque clearance.
